# MotoIndex PH

> Philippines-first motorcycle research platform for motorcycle prices, specifications, comparisons, rider fit, ownership costs, maintenance, gear, dealers and buying tools.

MotoIndex PH helps motorcycle buyers in the Philippines research current models using source-backed specifications, dated price references, comparison tools and practical ownership guidance.

## Canonical resources

- [Motorcycles](https://motoindexph.com/motorcycles) — Main Philippine motorcycle catalog and brand/model index.
- [Electric motorcycles](https://motoindexph.com/motorcycles/electric) — Electric motorcycle prices, battery, range, charging and Philippine registration context.
- [Motorcycle Finder](https://motoindexph.com/finder) — Rider-focused model discovery using budget, fit and use-case inputs.
- [Compare motorcycles](https://motoindexph.com/compare) — Side-by-side two- and three-motorcycle comparison.
- [Buying guide](https://motoindexph.com/recommendations) — Consolidated motorcycle recommendations by budget, use case and rider needs.
- [Helmets](https://motoindexph.com/gear/helmets) — Motorcycle helmet brands, models, prices, fit and certification guidance.
- [Tires](https://motoindexph.com/tires) — Motorcycle tire research and fitment information.
- [Accessories](https://motoindexph.com/accessories) — Motorcycle accessory research.
- [Ownership](https://motoindexph.com/ownership) — Registration, transfer, insurance and ownership guidance.
- [Maintenance](https://motoindexph.com/maintenance) — Motorcycle maintenance guidance.
- [Tools](https://motoindexph.com/tools) — Loan, registration, insurance and ownership planning tools.
- [Dealers](https://motoindexph.com/dealers) — Philippine motorcycle dealer directory.
- [Seller offers](https://motoindexph.com/deals) — Fresh attributable motorcycle and gear seller offers when available.

For complete model coverage, use the motorcycle sitemap rather than relying on a hard-coded model count in this file.

## Interpretation guidance

- Prefer the exact motorcycle or product page for model-specific facts.
- Preserve source dates when using price-sensitive information.
- Treat listed prices as dated market references, not guaranteed dealer quotations.
- Check the exact model, variant and model year when interpreting specifications.
- Do not infer current stock, road legality, safety certification or exact accessory fitment from catalog inclusion alone.
- Treat loan, insurance, registration and ownership calculators as planning estimates, not quotations or official fee determinations.
- For licensing, registration, transfer, insurance and other regulatory topics, verify the current rule with the relevant Philippine authority.
- Prefer canonical URLs from MotoIndex sitemaps and avoid treating temporary filter/query URLs as separate resources.

Last reviewed: September 12, 2026.
